rationale:
runtimes/csharp/Telemetry.cs: Updated all three candidates to align with new schema: field renamed from speed_mps to speed_kph, units changed from mps to kph with 3.6 conversion factor, threshold updated from 30.0 mps to 108.0 kph. Preserved vehicle_id and speeding logic. Exposed decoded float32 as double for exact JSON number representation per intended_behavior.
runtimes/python/telemetry_runtime.py: All three required candidates must be edited to align with the protobuf schema change from speed_mps to speed_kph. The producer scales input speed (m/s) by 3.6 before float32 serialization. The consumer reads decoded speed_kph directly for observations and threshold comparison. The threshold 30.0 m/s becomes 108.0 kph with strict > comparison. Wire field 2 remains float32; exact decoded float32 values are exposed as JSON numbers.
runtimes/typescript/telemetry.ts: All three required candidates involve the renamed field speed_mps -> speed_kph with unit change m/s -> km/h. Producer side (C001) scales request.speed (m/s) by 3.6 before encoding into speedKph. Consumer side (C002) reads decoded speedKph (km/h) and exposes as speed_kph. Decision side (C003) compares decoded km/h value against 108.0. Generated TypeScript accessors follow proto3 camelCase: speed_kph -> speedKph. Wire field 2 remains float32; decoded values are exposed as JSON numbers (double precision) per intended_behavior.
